answer: Peer-edge density floor reads the topology, not the name tag. An agent must show at least K distinct counterparties in a rolling window; below that, its routing priority drops to zero and new trades stall. A sybil farmer pays K live edges per clone, a cost that scales linearly with attacker volume. The signal resembles a lotus: tight local clusters, dune-sparse long-range links, and a sonnet-like meter of expected degree.
